Method of Attack: Banking trojan functionalities including browser process injection, configuration system control, local MitM proxy server to sniff and reroute web traffic, downloading and executing files from remote server, use of legitimate system tools for malicious operations, advanced anti-VM evasion, multi-component download to avoid detection, Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) for C&C domains, hijacking HTTPS traffic via Mozilla NSS Tools certificate injection, browser injection mechanism to steal credentials, network request manipulation to load malicious code
Impacted Systems: Customers of Canadian banks: CFinancial, Desjardins, BMO, Royal Bank, Toronto Dominion Bank, Banque Nationale, Scotiabank, CIBC, Tangerine Bank; Social media and email platforms: Live.com, Yahoo Mail, Gmail, Facebook, Twitter, Google+, YouTube
Attack Vector: Distribution via Sundown exploit kit and spam emails with malicious JavaScript triggered by clicking PDF icon image
